Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86725966493
Zoom Meeting ID: 867 2596 6493
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 867 2596 6493#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.

  MINUTES
  OF THE APRIL 27, 2021 REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom
pursuant to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020,
was called to order by Mayor Kemps at 6:39 P.M. on April 27, 2021 , notice having been given
with affidavit thereto on file . Members of the public were provided with the following
information to provide public input:

  BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86725966493
  Zoom Meeting ID: 867 2596 6493
  BY TELEPHONE: 1669900 9128, Enter Code: 867 2596 6493#
  BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R21-17

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 021-750

CALL TO ORDER 6:39 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENT: Mayor Kemps, Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi, Councilmembers McGowan, Roos and
Murdock

ALSO PRESENT:
City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Cotti, Treasurer Greenberg, Police Chief Best,
Community Development Director Rindge, City Support Services Director Hannah, City Clerk
Chaney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, seconded by Councilmember McGowan to
approve the agenda.
AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
NOES: None

MAYOR'S REPORT-MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST

Mayor Kemps reported that he will be presenting a State of the City at the Malaga Cove Homes
Association meeting on May 3rd and a link will be provided on the City's website

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

City Manager Guglielmo noted that in April and May there will be an additional special meeting
of the Planning Commission. She also noted that on May 11 from 4 to 6 p.m. a special budget
workshop will be taking place before the regular City Council meeting.

Police Chief Best thanked the Palos Verdes Estates Foundation for their donation to support
Drone services for the Police Department.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
APRIL 27 , 2021
 8.  Approval of the Second Amendment to the Memorandum of Understanding

  Hills and Rolling Hills Estates (Peninsula CIMP Agencies) regarding the
  Administration and Cost Sharing for Implementing the Coordinated Integrated

  Authorized the Mayor to sign a letter in support of AB 1251.

  Authorized the Mayor to sign a comment letter regarding AB 1295.

PUBLIC HEARING(S)/ORDINANCES

11.  Ordinance No. 021-750 of the City of Palos Verdes Estates, California Amending
  Section 18.04.105 (Lot Coverage) of Chapter 18.04 (R-1 Zone) Of Title 18 (Zoning
  Regulations) of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code and Finding the Action
  Exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act Regulating the
  Measurement of Building Coverage

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, Seconded by Councilmember Roos
  to introduce on first reading, by title only, proposed Ordinance No. 021-750: an
  ordinance of the City of Palos Verdes Estates, California amending Section 18.04.105
  (Lot Coverage) of Chapter 18. 04 (R-1 Zone) of Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) of the
  Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code and finding the action exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act.
  AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES: None

OLD BUSINESS

NEW BUSINESS

12.  Receive and File a Presentation from the City Manager and the Director of City
  Support Services Related to (A) Third Quarter Financial Reports and Budget
  Assessment to March 31, 2021; (B) Updated Financial Projections for Fiscal Year
  2020-21; (C) Scenarios of the City's Pension Debt to June 30, 2021; and (D)
  Review of an Updated Draft Version of the Long-Range Financial Plan.

  The City Support Services Director presented the third quarter financial reports and
  budget assessment, updated financial projections for FY 20-21, scenarios for
  measuring current pension debt, and presented an updated draft long-range financial
  plan. The City Council suggested changes to the presentation going forward, including
  changing the column heading "Actuals Budget Basis" to "Year-End Forecast" and
  breaking out the "other taxes" revenue category. Additionally, the Council directed
  staff to reflect the year over year increase in pension debt, as identified in the Certified
  Annual Financial Report (CAFR), in 21-22 City Budget documents, but not to include
  any additional funds to reduce this debt in the budget itself until Council provides such
  direction. Council anticipates creating a pension funding policy and will consider
  pension debt along with all other unmet financial needs in the coming months. The

 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
 APRIL 27, 2021
   City Council also requested a future agenda item for the creation of an ad-hoc
  committee to review the Los Angeles County Fire Department services agreement.

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

13.  Receipt and Filing of the Quarterly Treasurer's Reports for the Quarters Ending
  December 31, 2020 and March 31, 2021

  The City Treasurer presented her quarterly investment reports for quarters ending
  December 31, 2020 and March 31 , 2020. Council discussed the issue of asset liquidity
  and strategies for improving the portfolios overall performance including laddering
  and investing in higher yield taxable municipal bonds and commercial paper.

MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS

Councilmember Roos attended the recent South Bay Cities Council of Governments meeting in
which they considered and approved the Planner position. He noted that the City Council did not
support the additional position due to concerns for maintaining local control and that the Board
agreed to amend the Resolution to clarify its support for local control. He abstained from the
vote and requested a future agenda item for Council to consider the assessment for the position.
Councilmember Lozzi supported this request.

Councilmember Murdock attended a Cal Cities governance, transparency and labor relations
policy committee meeting with a CalPERS representative. She noted CalPERS is seeking input
from cities regarding competing desires for lower volatility and high yield in investments. She
also noted that she will be attending a meeting later in the week with Councilmember McGowan
for a Golf Club and Tennis Club taskforce update.

Councilmember McGowan attended the Sanitation District Board meeting, and also noted the
upcoming meeting with the Golf and Tennis Clubs.

Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi encouraged residents to apply for the Commission and Committee
vacancies.

ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, May 11, 2021AT6:30 P.M.

ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, seconded by Councilmember Murdock to
adjourn the meeting at 8:50 p.m.
AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
NOES: None

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  APPROVED:

  Michael Kemps, Mayor
